verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Ollama serving models that users chat with, and launching third-party coding agents through CLI commands such as `ollama launch`. Nothing shows that Ollama itself can be operated through natural-language commands, such as pulling, removing, configuring or switching models by plain-language instruction. Chatting with a hosted model and integrations like OpenClaw are adjacent uses of the models, not natural-language control of the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
